'''Dobbis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|goddess]] of [[Water/Legends|rain]] in the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Along with the [[Deity/Legends|god]] of fresh [[Water/Legends|water]],<ref name="SWGB" /> [[Gob Gobba]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|409|Oma-Oma}}</ref> Dobbis was viewed as an important nature deity and was overseen by the primary deity [[Oma-Oma]].<ref name="SWGB" /> On Naboo, a [[Dobbis (statue)|statue]] of Dobbis, which shared the god's name, was located on a [[Stone/Legends|stone]] cliff alongside a stream that overlooked a waterfall. Sometime before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="EpI" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="SWGB" /> the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Swagg]] sent two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to steal the statue of Dobbis among others, but the droids were stopped by the Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="EpI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The statue of Dobbis appeared in the [[2000]] novel [[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea|''Pirates from Beyond the Sea'']], written by [[Ryder Windham]] as the eleventh installment of ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' series.<ref name="EpI" /> Dobbis was later specified to be a Gungan goddess in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] version of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="SWGB" />
